gap: The interface contract supports a local invocation-order check, but executable harness assembly requires the actual package declaration, followerReplication definition, and Future interface. The proposed check will deliver an instrumented AppendFuture through an AppendPipeline to the actual Raft.pipelineDecode, record whether Error returned before Response was invoked, and stop at Response entry without supplying invented response fields. Channel delivery controls availability of the single future; recovery from a harness-owned sentinel can stop observation before response interpretation. This checks the interface precondition only, without establishing network failure reachability or replication consequences.

requests.reason: Inspect the package declaration and followerReplication fields needed to initialize the actual consumer's state before its Response call.
Inspect the actual Future interface embedded by AppendFuture so the instrumented future implements the complete required interface without guessing internal APIs.
